executionRules: PRE-1 is cleared (commit 92f0635). PRE-2 remains open and gates only P5.3 in wave 6 — it does not block starting. Never execute a gated work package while its precondition is open.
Read plans/INDEX.md first, then plans/program.json, then the plan file for the work package being executed.
Never start a work package whose dependsOn entries are not all status=complete.
Execute in executionOrder, or parallelize within a single wave only — never across waves.
Plan 06 runs first and blocks all five other plans. Do not reorder it.
Plan 04 runs last. P4.2/P4.3 require P5.7 quarantine first; P4.4 requires P3.7 and P2.9. Pruning early destroys target locations.
A work package is complete only when every acceptance criterion in its plan file is verifiably true. Never self-report completion from intent.
Never fabricate content to satisfy a gate. If NEB past papers are unavailable, mark sourced-pending and escalate.
Never write a completion claim the filesystem does not support. Status files are generated from measurement.

The 239 curriculum blocks are declared gaps, not defects. A 0-byte notes.md in a status=not-started block is exempt from the hollow detector (PLAN-05 §5.1); the exemption is derived from curriculum-map.json at run time and shrinks as blocks are authored. Never fabricate notes to clear CI, and never hand-edit _subject.json status/notes/notesBytes.

The 481 scaffold files are uncommitted (HEAD 92f0635 predates them). Wave 0 does not touch curriculum/ or tools/, so it is safe to start. Before any later destructive step, commit or uniquely-tag-stash them per the git rule. Do not commit without a new explicit owner authorization.

Before any destructive step run git status from C:/Users/ASUS/simulation (now the correct scoped root, HEAD 92f0635). NEVER run git commands from C:/Users/ASUS — that home-rooted repo has zero commits and would sweep the entire user profile. Stash with a unique tag and restore with apply, never pop.
Back up bytes before transcoding or pruning; retain backups until the corresponding CI gate is green.
Update workPackages[].status in this manifest as work completes so the next agent inherits accurate state.
